prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Caesium (Cs) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a pharmacy dispensing room with a long wooden counter, drawers of unlabelled glass jars, a brass scale and tall shelves
Time of day: night — the scene lit by lamps, screens or windows, dark outside.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a modern daily qipao — fitted mandarin-collar dress with frog buttons and side slits — in warm earth tones such as camel, olive, rust, chocolate or burgundy; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing at a waist-high railing or sill.
COMPOSITION: a waist-up shot of her head, torso and hands; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; camera at her eye level; she is placed in the left third of the frame, open space of the place to her right; the space runs far back behind her, its lines receding into the distance.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests on the railing — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small screwdriver at chest height; it is all she holds.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: one eye closed in a playful wink while the other stays open and bright, one mouth corner lifted in a small smile, brows relaxed.

Framing: a waist-up shot — the bottom edge crosses her waist; hips, legs and feet are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — caesium: a soft, pale-gold alkali metal that melts in a warm hand at about 28 degrees and explodes on touching water, the most violently reactive of the stable alkali metals, so it is kept sealed in glass ampoules under inert gas; found in 1860 in boiled-down spring water, the first element ever discovered with the spectroscope, and named from Latin caesius, sky blue, for the two bright blue lines in its flame; since 1967 the second is defined as 9,192,631,770 vibrations of the caesium atom, counted by atomic clocks — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
acceptance: user chose 1,1,1 and authorized main publication

observations: Original verified 1024x1536; one adult woman in focus; reference face/hair colour and painterly rendering followed.
Two connected arms and visible hands.
Holds an ampoule rather than planned small screwdriver; wink differs from planned expression.
qa.cause: Generation departed from a planned prop, pose, costume or text constraint; original preserved without regeneration.
